title: Perform Operator Station Daily Preventive Maintenance Checks (Controller, Stacklights, Chute Debris)
summary: Perform a daily operator station inspection to verify the operator station is safe/ready for operation by checking for controller damage, confirming stacklights are operational, and ensuring the chute is free of debris such as stuck labels.
when_to_use: Use this procedure for daily preventive maintenance checks of the OptiSweep operator station to confirm it is safe/ready for operation (controller condition, stacklights operational, chute free of debris such as stuck labels).
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the daily visual inspection at the operator station and stop/escalate if any unsafe condition is observed (controller damage, non-operational stacklights, or debris/stuck labels in the chute).
safety_notes: If any controller damage is observed, or stacklights are not operational, or debris/stuck labels are found in the chute, stop the daily inspection and escalate to maintenance/support as required by site practice.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the operator station

visual_references.description: Labeled photograph of the operator station showing controller area components including chute and stacklights (used to orient where to inspect).
Photo of the three-segment stacklight assembly (used to visually confirm what an operational stacklight looks like).

steps.purpose: Confirm the operator station controller is not damaged before proceeding with operation readiness.
steps.instruction: Go to the operator station and visually inspect the controller area for any damage.
steps.expected_result: The controller shows no visible damage.
steps.healthy_condition: No visible damage is observed on the controller area at the operator station.
steps.failure_condition: Damage to the controller is observed.

steps.failure_condition: Debris/stuck labels are present in the chute.

stop_or_escalate_if: Debris/stuck labels are found in the chute

steps.title: Stop inspection and escalate if any unsafe condition is found
steps.purpose: Prevent operation when daily readiness checks fail and ensure maintenance/support is engaged.
steps.instruction: If any controller damage is found, or stacklights are not operational, or debris is present in the chute, stop the daily inspection and escalate to maintenance/support as required by site practice.
